about_the_game:
Voidborn is a fast-paced roguelite FPS set in a crumbling dark fantasy world where the player takes on the role of a Voidborn - a powerful being created for one purpose; kill.

Dash, slide, and wall-run through ancient underground cities, lava filled caves, blood soaked ruins, dark castles, and massive tombs. Slay demons to receive themed powerups to your different weapons and follow their upgrade paths to create devastating builds.

  • Use a wide variety of movement abilities to platform and avoid attacks.

  • Create devastating weapon- and character builds.

  • Face hordes of many different enemies and challenge tough bosses.

Grow stronger with every rebirth with permanent abilites and weapon upgrades as you face inevitable death. Challenge the demi-gods and avenge god to fulfill your destiny as a Voidborn.

  • Evolve after each death with permanent abilities and weapon upgrades.

  • Journey through a vast and varied dark fantasy world with unlockable shortcuts.

  • Take on the Trials of the Scarlet Curse, a custom difficulty system that ramps up the intensity to game-changing insanity.
